intro: Antigua is low and dry with many bays; Barbuda is flat with pink sand beaches.

chapters.title: Land
text: Antigua's coastline is full of coves. Barbuda has a large frigatebird colony. Boggy Peak, renamed Mount Obama, is the highest point.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The islands are dry and sunny, with hurricanes in some years.

keyTerms.meaning: A seabird with a red throat pouch.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Antigua and Barbuda's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
